context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 124 tested the new Candidate Activity Log feature. All 14 action types are tracked (captured, updated, cv_uploaded, cv_replaced, applied, linked, stage_changed, note_added, approval, match_scored, viewed, shortlisted, rejected, profile_edited). Activity logging is integrated into candidate view and edit endpoints. Frontend has Activity Feed page at /{role}/activity-feed and Timeline tab on candidate full profile. One bug was fixed: NaukriProfileView.jsx was using undefined 'id' variable instead of 'candidateId' from useParams().
